create_Counter: create a Counter instance with an optional start value and call __next__ to get incrementing integers
create_AtomicCounter: create an AtomicCounter instance with an optional initial value for thread-safe counting
test_AtomicCounter_inc: test the AtomicCounter inc method increments the value atomically and returns the new value
test_AtomicCounter_dec: test the AtomicCounter dec method decrements the value atomically and returns the new value
test_Counter_reset: test the Counter reset method sets the internal counter back to zero
